page.title: Smartodo | Local-First Task Manager with Task Dependency Graph
page.description: Smartodo is an intelligent, local-first task manager with a native task dependency graph (DAG), visual workflows, and offline-first privacy for logic thinkers.
page.keywords: Smartodo, task dependency graph, DAG, local-first todo, task manager, visual workflow, productivity tool, GTD
page.ogTitle: Smartodo - Local-First Task Manager with Task Dependency Graph
page.ogDescription: An intelligent, local-first task manager with native task dependency graphs (DAG) and visual workflows.
page.ldDescription: Smartodo is a local-first task manager featuring a native task dependency graph (DAG), visual workflows, and offline-first intelligence for logic thinkers.
page.heroTitle: Smartodo is a local-first task manager with intelligence
page.heroBody: Plan work as a graph of tasks that know what blocks them, ask the AI agent to build or update that plan, and keep everything on your device, synced through storage you own.
page.featuresTitle: Privacy-first productivity with an AI boost
page.localAria: Animated sync: a phone keeps working offline, then its changes merge with edits from other devices through the user's own cloud storage.
page.localLead: Works offline. Syncs through storage you own.
page.localBody1: Every edit saves on your device first, then syncs through your own Google Drive or WebDAV.
page.localBody2: Our server only relays a change signal, so your devices update in real time.
page.graphAria: Animated dependency graph: finishing a task automatically unlocks the tasks that depend on it.
page.graphLead: See blockers before they slow work down.
page.graphBody: Track task relationships in a live dependency graph that stays in sync with your board.
page.agentAria: Animated chat: one sentence asks the AI agent to plan a trip, and it creates the tasks, links their dependencies, then reprioritizes on request.
page.agentLead: Turn one sentence into a linked plan.
page.agentBody: Smart AI Agent creates tasks, links their dependencies, and updates priorities and due dates when you ask.
page.filtersAria: Animated filter: three conditions narrow eight tasks down to the open work blocking v1.0 that is due this week, the filter is saved, and its count updates when a task is finished.
page.filtersLead: Ask your list exactly what you need.
page.filtersBody: Combine status, importance, title, due dates, and dependencies with AND / OR, like everything still blocking a release that's due this week.
page.footerRights: © 2025 Synthetic Insights LLC. All rights reserved.
page.footerTagline: Built with privacy, for people who care about focus.
